title: How Roy Eldridge introduced Babe to Mr. Fox
summary: Joe first heard Babe's name when Roy Eldridge told Ed Fox that Babe Matthews was all the Terrace needed. Babe had worked with Nat and Eddie Cole at the Panama.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: By the first time I heard her name, it happened in musical sequence, I would say. So, things weren't going too out good xx there. Earl had his band out there and they'd come in and do a maybe a show, I mean a radio show to no people.
Oh, I see, that would be ...
Ed Fox had things happen there. And, the first time I heard Babe's name, it was always musical. I was talking about it before.
I see. So, you knew that whole scene...
No, she didn't. She was in a strange situation.

She worked out with Nat Cole and Eddie Cole at a place called the Panama. You know, the great Nat Cole and Eddie Cole were at a place called the Panama. But the first time I heard her name, you know Roy is always a very forward person. He's my buddy all the way.

He's got to be. He's got to be. So he says to Mr. Fox, now remember this is Mr. Fox of the Grand Terrace. Do you know this place, Mr. Fox? He said, What do you mean, Roy? He said, Babe Matthews, that's all you need. Can we stop now? I need a rest sometime now.
No, you got to keep talking. So what happens now? How does your romance prosper after this bad beginning?
